note: Mali's Embassy in Japan (Avis N°003/AMJT/2023, 12 April 2023, read 2026-11-03): after the RAVEC's data were corrected, the Government began withdrawing the secure biometric identity card in the withdrawal centres, embassies and consulates among them, on 11 April 2023. Until then the entry held the card of 2015 as the IRB of Canada's response (February 2015) gave it: from 18, fiscal stamps and legal fees of 1,700 francs CFA, ready in 24 hours, valid three years. That card has been replaced, and the new card's fee, term and time weren't found, so they're null and the player is told; the age stays the last one read, 18. Decree 2022-0639/PT-RM, which reportedly sets the new card's terms, wasn't read.

sources.title: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada, Mali: Requirements and procedures to obtain a national identity card (2012-February 2015), on ecoi.net
sources.said: fiscal stamps (500 + 200 CFA francs) [approximately $CDN1.10 + $CDN0.10] Legal fees: 1,000 CFA [approximately $CDN2.20 ] when picking up the card, along with a receipt. Delay necessary to obtain the card: 24 hours ... a national identity card is valid for three years, as indicated on the back of the card ... upon reaching the age of majority (18 years old) and who is officially considered a citizen of Mali, has the right to obtain a national identity card

sources.title: Ambassade de la République du Mali au Japon, Avis N°003/AMJT/2023 (Tokyo, 12 avril 2023)
sources.said: le Gouvernement malien, après la phase de correction et de mise à jour des données du RAVEC, a annoncé le démarrage de la phase nationale de retrait de la carte d’identité biométrique sécurisée, le mardi 11 avril 2023, dans les différents centres d’enlèvement, notamment dans les Ambassades et Consulats.
